name: Mounts
author: jgarza
description: Manage saved network mounts (SMB, SFTP/SSH, NFS): add connections, mount and unmount with one click, auto-mount at login, passwords kept in the keyring.

barWidget.description: Network drive icon with the number of mounted connections; click opens Mounts.

schema.label: Show count
schema.description: Show how many connections are mounted next to the icon.

schema.label: Hide when empty
schema.description: Hide the icon until you have saved a connection.

schema.label: Refresh every (s)
schema.description: How often the mounted count is re-checked.
